title: Good slicing radii in the dyadic intervals ((1/2)^{j+3}, (1/2)^{j+2})
statement: Assume, as a hypothesis of the statement, (GR) (verbatim the frozen Lean type of the selected node's resolved dependency with key good_radius): for P ∈ ℕ, finite measures μ, μ′ on ℝ^P (IsFiniteMeasure), f : ℝ^P → ℝ measurable, a real ρ > 0 and B ∈ [0, ∞] with μ({f < ρ}) ≤ B, there is r with ρ/2 < r < ρ, liminf_{h→0+} ofReal(h⁻¹)·μ({r − h < f < r}) ≤ ofReal(4/ρ)·B and liminf_{h→0+} ofReal(h⁻¹)·μ′({r − h < f < r}) < ∞ (liminf along the filter 𝓝[>] 0, values in [0, ∞]). Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let μ, μ′ be finite measures on ℝ^P, d : ℝ^P → ℝ measurable, C ∈ ℝ≥0 and M, M′ ∈ [0, ∞] with M ≠ ∞ and M′ ≠ ∞, and assume that for every real r with 0 < r ≤ 1/4, μ({d < r}) ≤ C·ofReal(r^{m+2})·M and μ′({d < r}) ≤ C·ofReal(r^{m+2})·M′ (in [0, ∞], ofReal = ENNReal.ofReal). Then there is r : ℕ → ℝ such that: (i) (1/2)^{j+3} < r_j < (1/2)^{j+2} for every j ∈ ℕ; (ii) r is strictly decreasing; (iii) for every j, μ({d < r_j}) ≤ C·ofReal((1/2)^{(j+2)(m+2)})·M and μ′({d < r_j}) ≤ C·ofReal((1/2)^{(j+2)(m+2)})·M′; (iv) μ({d < r_j}) → 0 and μ′({d < r_j}) → 0 as j → ∞; (v) for every j, liminf_{h→0+} ofReal(h⁻¹)·μ({r_j − h < d < r_j}) ≤ 4·C·ofReal((1/2)^{(j+2)(m+1)})·M; (vi) for every j, liminf_{h→0+} ofReal(h⁻¹)·μ′({r_j − h < d < r_j}) < ∞. Here liminf is taken along the filter 𝓝[>] 0 of right neighbourhoods of 0, and {r_j − h < d < r_j} = {x : r_j − h < d(x) ∧ d(x) < r_j}.
lean_statement: (∀ (P : ℕ) (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (B : ℝ≥0∞), IsFiniteMeasure μ → IsFiniteMeasure μ' → Measurable f → 0 < ρ → μ {x | f x < ρ} ≤ B → ∃ r ∈ Ioo (ρ / 2) ρ, liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ {x | r - h < f x ∧ f x < r}) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (4 / ρ) * B ∧ liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ' {x | r - h < f x ∧ f x < r}) (𝓝[>] 0) < ∞) → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (d : Euclid P → ℝ) (C : NNReal) (M M' : ℝ≥0∞), IsFiniteMeasure μ → IsFiniteMeasure μ' → Measurable d → M ≠ ∞ → M' ≠ ∞ → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 1 / 4 → μ {x | d x < r} ≤ C * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (m + 2)) * M ∧ μ' {x | d x < r} ≤ C * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (m + 2)) * M') → ∃ r : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ j, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 3) < r j ∧ r j < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 2)) ∧ StrictAnti r ∧ (∀ j, μ {x | d x < r j} ≤ C * ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ((j + 2) * (m + 2))) * M ∧ μ' {x | d x < r j} ≤ C * ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ((j + 2) * (m + 2))) * M') ∧ Tendsto (fun j => μ {x | d x < r j}) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ Tendsto (fun j => μ' {x | d x < r j}) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ (∀ j, liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ {x | r j - h < d x ∧ d x < r j}) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ 4 * C * ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ((j + 2) * (m + 1))) * M) ∧ (∀ j, liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ' {x | r j - h < d x ∧ d x < r j}) (𝓝[>] 0) < ∞)
